purpose: Restore founding inquiry coverage BEFORE applying local LIRA numeric priority. This is research planning, not a validated ontology.

rules: Research importance ≠ local novelty left; pre-existing scholarly explanations reduce novelty claims, not the requirement to study a historical counterexample.
One missing source prompts hold or alternate witness, not silent deletion of a founding dimension.
No scalar weighting can override seven founding questions or delete cross-branch protected cases.
Every completed historical mechanism needs a dated experimental witness, a failure/near-miss witness, and a viable scholarly rival.
No new scientific version or authority follows from formal unit tests or unchanged source count.
